profile_text.body:
Cisco is a publicly traded worldwide technology company (Nasdaq: CSCO, CIK 0000858877) that describes itself as a leader in AI infrastructure, secure networking, and software solutions. Its site presents a broad portfolio spanning AI-optimized networking, purpose-built programmable silicon for AI workloads, data center modernization, and security embedded across network layers. The company positions its offerings for hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers, and notes that the McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team uses its networking and security products for AI workload processing across race events.

On the AI product side, Cisco tracks Cisco Webex AI, a meeting intelligence platform offering real-time translation, noise removal, and enterprise security. The company also describes Cisco IQ as a unified AI-powered experience delivering real-time insights, troubleshooting, automation, and agent-driven guidance to support professional services. More broadly, Cisco's site emphasizes a move toward autonomous network operations through policy-bound agents that execute complex workflows while human oversight governs intent, policy, and risk.

The held facts show no active litigation or MCP server registrations on record for Cisco at this time.
